title: MLOps Default Prediction Pipeline
summary: An MLOps pipeline for loan default prediction that orchestrates data generation, training, evaluation, and deployment using PyTorch, Airflow, and MongoDB. Its data ingestion stage loads a pre-trained SDV GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate synthetic loan application data for the daily pipeline run.
